name: Carhartt Sandstone Sierra Sherpa-Lined Jacket for Men - Dark Brown - M
description: The Carhartt® Sandstone Sherpa-Lined Sierra Jacket for Men is a wind-resistant jacket that keeps you warm as you work in wintry weather. Protection starts with the durable, 12-oz. 100% cotton sandstone duck canvas exterior; it's rugged, wind-resistant, and warm. 100% polyester sherpa lining in the body and hood helps trap body heat, and 100% nylon quilted lining in the sleeves allows your arms to move freely. As always, this Carhart work jacket is built tough with triple-stitched main seams. A pleated bi-swing back and elbows ensure freer, easier movement. The Carhartt Sandstone Sherpa-Lined Sierra Jacket is outfitted with 2 front handwarmer pockets, a zip left-chest pocket, 2 interior pockets, and rib-knit storm cuffs. Machine wash.
